paragraphs: Hyman mentions him at the end of halakhah 1 in Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot, chapter 10, reporting in the name of R' Yochanan.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman’s chapter 10, end-of-halakhah-1 locator and the direction of reporting in the name of R' Yochanan are retained as his notice. The entire named Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 10:1 section, six whole text scalars, does not contain the sought Achiyya/Yochanan report. This is a bounded edition-and-locator nonmatch, not absence elsewhere or proof of another numbering. Both source-abbreviated titles remain R'; no Hebrew, locator, teacher relation or identity is corrected from that lookup.
